acceptanceCriteria: A suite loading more than 256 non-node_modules modules but within the new bound produces a qualified receipt (test).

Exceeding the new bound refuses with a distinct config-inputs-overflow reason naming observed count and limit, not report-output-overflow (test); docs/specs/playwright-external-provider-v0.md updated.
body: Source: GitHub beamfall/corvint#844 (2026-10-12). internal/jstestprovider/qualified-reporter.cjs records every non-node_modules require.cache module as a config input; above 256 entries bindQualifiedReport (internal/jstestprovider/external.go:480,488) refuses report-identity-unknown with reason report-output-overflow, though the report output is small. A mid-size suite hits it after two support modules. Expected: a cap sized for real suites (or byte-bounded) and a distinct reason config-inputs-overflow stating observed count and limit.
title: External Playwright provider: 256 config-input cap refuses ordinary suites as report-output-overflow (GitHub #844)
